summary: One frozen, typed set that certifies every claimed M5 debugger-facing row against the shared debug object model and its evidence corpus, and narrows the published claim automatically when debugger evidence is stale, partial, or failing. Each qualification row binds the debugger object families it claims to the proof packets that keep it current, computes one qualification status from evidence freshness and completeness, and derives the maturity the product is allowed to publish — stable only when certified with a supported, exact-mapping backend. Claim publications for the claim board, About/help/service-health, support exports, and release packets republish the narrowest maturity across the rows they cover, and downgrade rules name why each claim narrowed.

qualification_rows.title: Launch / attach session and target descriptors
qualification_rows.summary: Launch, attach, core-file, replay, and inspect-only session modes stay distinct with fresh descriptor evidence; published stable.

qualification_rows.title: Breakpoint specs and frame mapping
qualification_rows.summary: Verified breakpoints and exact frame mappings carry current spec evidence; published stable.

qualification_rows.title: Variables, watches, evaluate, and console
qualification_rows.narrowing_reason: Claim narrowed to retest-pending: debugger evidence is aging toward its freshness SLO.
qualification_rows.summary: Variable/watch and evaluate/console evidence is aging toward its SLO; the stable claim narrows to retest-pending until a fresh capture lands.

qualification_rows.title: Notebook debugger bridge and frame-to-cell parity
qualification_rows.summary: The notebook bridge offers a disclosed-divergent subset of debug parity; published preview honestly, not narrowed.

qualification_rows.title: Notebook debug support states on unsupported kernels
qualification_rows.narrowing_reason: Claim narrowed to retest-pending: debugger evidence aged past its freshness SLO.
qualification_rows.summary: Unsupported-kernel debug-state evidence is stale; the preview claim narrows to retest-pending and discloses no notebook parity or chronology.

qualification_rows.title: Profiler replay session and chronology capture
qualification_rows.summary: Replay sessions are inspect-only with limited reverse-step support and approximate frame mapping; published preview honestly, not narrowed.

qualification_rows.title: Imported replay capture with build mismatch
qualification_rows.narrowing_reason: Claim narrowed to preview: debugger evidence is partial for the claimed scope.
qualification_rows.summary: An imported replay capture maps against a mismatched build with partial evidence; the stable claim narrows to preview.

qualification_rows.title: Incident crash dump symbolication
qualification_rows.narrowing_reason: Claim withdrawn: required debugger evidence is missing.
qualification_rows.summary: No current symbolication evidence is available and mapping is unresolved; the claim is withdrawn until a resolved report lands.

qualification_rows.title: Support-export of variables, console, and session
qualification_rows.narrowing_reason: Claim withdrawn: this debugger surface is blocked by policy.
qualification_rows.summary: Support export of debugger state is blocked by policy; the claim is withdrawn from the product surface.

qualification_rows.title: Inspect-only replay of an unavailable-control capture
qualification_rows.summary: Live control and replay verbs are unavailable for this capture; published inspect-only honestly, not narrowed.

claim_publications.title: Core debugger claim board
claim_publications.narrowing_reason: Claim board narrowed to Retest pending: republishing the narrowest qualified debugger row it covers.
claim_publications.summary: The claim board republishes the narrowest core-debugger row; aging variable/evaluate evidence narrows the board to retest-pending.

claim_publications.title: About / help / service-health debugger claim
claim_publications.narrowing_reason: About / help / service-health narrowed to Retest pending: republishing the narrowest qualified debugger row it covers.
claim_publications.summary: About, help, and service-health republish the narrowest notebook/replay row; stale unsupported-kernel evidence narrows the surface to retest-pending.

claim_publications.title: Support-export debugger claim
claim_publications.narrowing_reason: Support export narrowed to Withdrawn: republishing the narrowest qualified debugger row it covers.
claim_publications.summary: Support exports republish the narrowest incident/support row; a withdrawn symbolication or policy-blocked export narrows the surface to withdrawn.

claim_publications.title: Release packet debugger claim
claim_publications.summary: The release packet republishes only the ship-required core rows; both hold stable so the packet stays stable.

downgrade_rules.title: Aging evidence narrows to retest-pending
downgrade_rules.summary: A row whose evidence is aging toward its freshness SLO narrows to retest-pending.

downgrade_rules.title: Stale evidence narrows to retest-pending
downgrade_rules.summary: A row whose evidence aged past its freshness SLO narrows to retest-pending.

downgrade_rules.title: Partial evidence narrows to preview
downgrade_rules.summary: A row with incomplete evidence for its claimed scope narrows to preview.

downgrade_rules.title: Missing evidence withdraws the claim
downgrade_rules.summary: A row with no current evidence is withdrawn from the product surface.

downgrade_rules.title: Degraded support class narrows to preview
downgrade_rules.summary: A row whose backend support is below supported narrows at least to preview.

downgrade_rules.title: Degraded mapping fidelity narrows to preview
downgrade_rules.summary: A row without an exact, exact-build mapping narrows at least to preview.

downgrade_rules.title: Lost notebook parity narrows to preview
downgrade_rules.summary: A notebook row with divergent or unsupported parity narrows at least to preview.

downgrade_rules.title: Lost replay evidence narrows to preview
downgrade_rules.summary: A replay-claiming row with below-supported replay narrows at least to preview.

downgrade_rules.title: Policy-blocked claim is withdrawn
downgrade_rules.summary: A row blocked by an explicit policy rule is withdrawn from the product surface.

invariants.statement: Every governed debugger object family is claimed by at least one qualification row.
Every debugger surface category — core runtime, notebook, profiler/replay, and incident/support — is materialized.
Every qualification status is materialized, so the narrowing machinery is exercised.
Every row's stored status, published maturity, and narrowing agree with the derivation from its disclosed evidence.
No row publishes stable unless its status is certified with a supported backend and an exact, exact-build mapping.
Every narrowed row carries a reviewable narrowing reason and every un-narrowed row carries none.
Every row whose status triggers narrowing publishes below stable.
Every claim publication republishes the narrowest maturity across the rows it covers and never a wider claim.
Every publication channel — claim board, About/help/service-health, support export, and release packet — is published exactly once.
Every active downgrade rule lists every row exhibiting its trigger and narrows each at least to its resulting maturity.
